description: Natural Hazards Research Summit 2024: AI-Assisted Workflows for Automated Extraction of Building Inventory and Damage Information from NHERI RAPID Reconnaissance Data is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Barbaros Cetiner, University of California Los Angeles (ucla.edu). This poster describes the latest capabilities of SimCenter's BRAILS tool, which now allows automated processing of RAPID image datasets to obtain building attributes required for natural hazard studies or generate maps of damaged buildings from reconnaissance data using AI. Coverage: College Park, MD. DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-9p7s-bz76. Keywords: SimCenter, RAPID, Artificial Intelligence, Reconnaissance. Published 2024-06-13. Facility named: SimCenter, RAPID - Natural Hazard and Disasters Reconnaissance Facility - University of Washington. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
